title: Spreadsheet with formulas and errors
prompt:
Evaluate a small spreadsheet. Its cells are named by a column letter A to D and a row number 1 to 5 (A1 to D5). Each filled cell holds an integer or a formula, which starts with `=`. Formulas use integers, cell names, the operators `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, a unary minus, parentheses, and the functions `SUM(X:Y)` and `MAX(X:Y)`, whose argument is the rectangle of cells with corners X (top left) and Y (bottom right). `*` and `/` bind tighter than `+` and `-`; operators of the same level are applied from left to right; a unary minus negates the value right after it (a number, a cell, a function call, a part in parentheses, or another unary minus). `a / b` is the whole number of times b fits into a (the remainder is discarded); in this sheet the operands of `/` are never negative. An empty cell has the value 0. `SUM` adds the values of the cells of its rectangle; `MAX` gives the largest of them (empty cells count as 0). The cells of a rectangle are used row by row, from left to right within a row.
Errors: a reference to a cell outside A1 to D5 (as a single cell or as a corner of a rectangle) gives `#REF`; a division by 0 gives `#DIV0`; using a cell whose result is an error gives that error. A formula is evaluated from left to right and its result is the first error that happens, if any. Cycles take precedence over all of that: a cell whose formula can reach itself by following references (a rectangle refers to all of its cells), or can reach a cell that can reach itself, has the result `#CYCLE`.
The filled cells: A1 `10`; B1 `=A1*2`; C1 `=B1+A2`; D1 `=SUM(A1:C1)`; A2 `3`; B2 `=A2-B1/4`; D2 `=MAX(A1:C2)*(C2+2)`; A3 `=B3+1`; B3 `=C3`; C3 `=A3*0`; D3 `=-C3`; A4 `=10/(A2-3)`; B4 `=A4+1`; C4 `=MAX(A1:B2)+D4`; D4 `=E1+1`; A5 `=SUM(A1:D2)-(A1+B1)*-2`; B5 `=B1/0+D4`; C5 `=SUM(C4:C5)`; D5 `=D4*0+B4`. Cell C2 is empty.
Print one line per filled cell, row by row from row 1 to row 5 and within a row from column A to column D: `CELL = RESULT`, where RESULT is the integer value or the error.
expected_output:
A1 = 10
B1 = 20
C1 = 23
D1 = 53
A2 = 3
B2 = -2
D2 = 46
A3 = #CYCLE
B3 = #CYCLE
C3 = #CYCLE
D3 = #CYCLE
A4 = #DIV0
B4 = #DIV0
C4 = #REF
D4 = #REF
A5 = 213
B5 = #DIV0
C5 = #CYCLE
D5 = #REF
